title: FunctionsPlaceholderVectorFunctionTask
description:
A compiled placeholder vector function task.

Always produces `Vector(vec![1/N; output_length])` before
the output expression is applied.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema defining the expected input structure.

output_length.description: Expression computing the expected output vector length.

input_split.description: Expression transforming input into sub-inputs for swiss system.

input_merge.description: Expression merging sub-inputs back into one input.

output.description: Expression to transform the equalized vector output.
